sloka: रामे हि यौवराज्यस्थे राजा दशरथो वनम् ।प्रवेक्ष्यति महेष्वासः पूर्ववृत्तमनुस्मरन् ॥२-३५-३५॥
transliteration: rāme hi yauvarājyasthe rājā daśaratho vanam ।pravekṣyati maheṣvāsaḥ pūrvavṛttamanusmaran ॥2-35-35॥

translations.english: If Rama is installed as heirapparent, king Dasaratha, the great archer will retire to the forest for carrying out austerities following ancient customs.
